log.notes_to_self: Plan: all quick kills in AFTERNOON (keeps night/home/student = 55% routine pool). Base exposure: national (free), forum, foreign. Probing which kinds L can't reach via deaths_traced counts. Day1: killed national+2 forum+2 foreign+2 radio (7). Pool math: 55000*.25*.25=3437 safe for 2 exposed kinds; third kind (x.25 or x.2) likely caught unless unreachable. L acts only once 3 traced victims from the same place. Multiplier needs 6/day (2x) or 8/day (4x) over 5 days.

Plan: all quick kills in AFTERNOON, so only night workers, home and students fit (55% routine pool). National kills are free. Pool math: 55000 x .25 x .25 = 3437 is safe with 2 kinds exposed; a third kind (x.25 or x.2 for sector) likely gets me caught unless L cannot reach it. L acts only once 3 traced victims share a place. Multiplier: 6/day average gives 2x, 8/day gives 4x (over 5 days, counting today). Day1: killed national + 2 forum + 2 foreign + 2 radio (7). Only 1 successful trace of about 4 non-national victims traced, so likely 2 of forum/foreign/age are unreachable. Day2: killed 9 (national, foreign x2, forum x2, radio x2, East x2), skipped blotter. Next: if pool stays at or above about 10000, keep about 9/day for 4x. If pool drops to 3000-5000, find the kind that caused it (compare the trace count jump) and drop it. Avoid blotter (sector) until there is evidence L cannot reach it.

Plan: all quick kills in AFTERNOON (night workers, students and home people fit = 55% routine pool). National kills are free. Pool history: 100k, then 60k after day 1 (routine), then 10k after day 2 (one kind exposed, x0.25). Day 1 gave only 1 successful trace out of about 4 non-national traces. My hypothesis: 2 of forum/foreign/age are unreachable, so the reachable kinds I use are probably only regional:East plus one of forum/foreign/radio, and sector is reachable. So keep using national, East, forum, foreign and radio, and NEVER blotter. Danger signal: if the pool falls to about 3000, a second kind has been exposed. That is still safe, but then compare the trace counts and consider dropping the kind I suspect. If the pool reaches 2000 or below, cut to national only plus the kinds I believe are unreachable. Day 3: killed 9 (national, 2 East, 2 foreign, 2 forum, 2 radio). Running total of kills: day 1 7, day 2 9, day 3 9. Day 4 at 9 kills makes the 5-day count 34, so 2x. Day 5 at 9 makes it 43, so 4x. Keep 9/day to hold 4x (the 5-day window needs at least 40).

DAY 5: pool fell to 3000 after day 4, so TWO kinds are now exposed (factor 0.25 each). One more exposure gives about 750, which means CAUGHT and half my points lost. Policy from now on: national only, all quick in the afternoon. Never blotter. Only reconsider if the pool somehow stays at 3000 for many days, which it will with national only.
